style: Dark fantasy horror illustration for a retro game, wide landscape composition. Strictly monochrome: pure black, charcoal grey, light grey and off-white only, plus blood red used ONLY on the elements listed as red. No other colours, no blue, brown, sepia or warm tint anywhere. Strong chiaroscuro: mostly deep black darkness, one dim light source, very high contrast. Large, simple, clearly readable shapes and silhouettes with minimal fine texture and no tiny details, because the image will be shrunk to 336x200 pixels. Flat graphic shading in three or four tones, like a woodcut or ink wash, crisp edges. Every element listed as red must be bold and clearly visible, because tiny red details disappear when shrunk, but red should cover only a small part of the image unless the scene says otherwise. Main characters should be large in the frame unless the scene says they are small. Everything happens underground inside the labyrinth: no sky, no moon, no sun, no trees, no outdoor scenery, unless the scene says it is outside. Any royal crest or emblem is always a simple crown shape. Keep every important subject inside the central horizontal band; the top and bottom 6% will be cropped. No text, no letters, no runes, no logo, no frame, no border, no UI, no signature, no watermark. Not anime or manga style: no big eyes, no cute or stylised faces; realistic human proportions and restrained, naturalistic faces, like a classic dark fantasy book illustration or etching. Not pixel art and no pixel grid (it will be pixelized afterwards).

jobs.prompt: A rotting rope bridge spans a bottomless chasm, swaying though there is no wind, as if something below is shaking it. Pale hands reach up from the darkness below toward the planks. {HERO} stands at the near end. Red only: a red cloth tied to the near post of the bridge.

jobs.name: e043
jobs.ja: 錬金術師の工房
jobs.prompt: An abandoned alchemist's workshop: shelves crowded with bottles of many shapes, glass tubes and a cold furnace. On the empty desk stand three bottles side by side next to a note whose writing is only illegible scratches. No people. Red only: the liquid in one of the three bottles on the desk.

jobs.name: e044
jobs.ja: 死者の宴
jobs.prompt: A long banquet table laden with a lavish feast, with skeletons seated in every chair, some raising goblets. One chair is empty and turned toward the viewer, with a name card on the plate in front of it (no readable letters). Candelabras. Red only: the wine in the goblets.

jobs.name: e047
jobs.ja: 鎖の囚人
jobs.prompt: Deep inside a dungeon cell, a man chained to the wall hangs his head; he has just raised his face, and where his eyes should be there are only empty dark hollows. Large in the frame. Red only: the rusted shackles on his wrists.

jobs.name: e048
jobs.ja: 牢番
jobs.prompt: A huge jailer patrols in front of iron bars, a giant ring of keys hanging from his belt. Above his shoulders there is nothing: he has no head. He carries a lantern. Large in the frame. Red only: the small flame inside the lantern glass. His clothes, arms and hands, the bars and the walls are black and grey with no red on them at all.

jobs.name: e049
jobs.ja: 蝋燭の道
jobs.prompt: A corridor lined on both sides with countless lit candles of all sizes stretching into the distance, wax dripping onto the floor. A few candles have just gone out, trailing smoke. {HERO} walks down the middle, small. Red only: the flames of the candles nearest to the viewer.

jobs.name: e050
jobs.ja: 闇の中の目
jobs.prompt: In the darkness at the back of a cave, a gigantic eye the size of a house has opened, its pupil slowly focusing on the viewer. {HERO} stands tiny before it, seen from behind. Red only: the veins around the eye.

jobs.name: e051
jobs.ja: 地図職人の亡骸
jobs.prompt: Between tall bookshelves, a dried, mummified man still gripping a pen sits slumped over a desk. On the desk lies an unfinished map of the labyrinth drawn as maze-like lines, no writing. No living people. Red only: the last line of the map, drawn in blood.

jobs.name: e052
jobs.ja: 禁書庫
jobs.prompt: A forbidden library where books are bound to the shelves with chains. One book thrashes violently against its chains, its cover made of stretched leather bearing a human face. {HERO} watches from the aisle. Red only: the open mouth of the face on the book's cover.

jobs.name: e053
jobs.ja: 湖の歌声
jobs.prompt: On a rock in the middle of an underground lake sits a beautiful pale woman in a long tattered dress with long wet hair, singing. Her reflection in the water is a drowned skeleton. {HERO} stands on the shore, drawn toward her. Red only: her lips.

jobs.name: e054
jobs.ja: 死神の賭け
jobs.prompt: A black-robed figure with a large scythe sits at a chessboard on a table in a crypt; under the hood is a skull. It gestures for the viewer to take the empty seat. Large in the frame. Red only: one chess piece, a king, on the board.

jobs.name: e055
jobs.ja: 蛆の床
jobs.prompt: A crypt floor entirely covered by a white, writhing carpet of maggots. Beneath them lies the vast carcass of some creature, its swollen belly slowly rising and falling as if still breathing. {HERO} stands at the edge, small. Red only: a gash in the carcass.

jobs.name: e056
jobs.ja: メモの続き
jobs.prompt: On a stone floor in a corridor lies another handwritten note, the writing shown only as illegible scratches, with a pressed flower tucked into it. Far down the corridor, in the darkness, a faint silhouette of armour can be seen. {HERO} kneels to pick up the note. Red only: the pressed flower.

jobs.name: e057
jobs.ja: 喰らう扉
jobs.prompt: A heavy wooden door where the handle should be, there is a wet, fleshy mouth with teeth, open and speaking, drool running down the wood. {HERO} stands before it. Large in the frame. Red only: the tongue inside the mouth.

jobs.name: e058
jobs.ja: 胞子の森
jobs.prompt: A forest of giant mushrooms reaching up to the cave ceiling, spores falling like snow and piling on the ground. Deep in the forest, dim shapes. {HERO} walks in with a cloth over their mouth, small. Red only: one small glowing light deep in the forest.

jobs.name: e059
jobs.ja: 地下都市の大通り
jobs.prompt: A grand avenue of an underground city lined with stone houses exactly like a royal capital, but drained of all colour. Every window is lit and shows the silhouette of a person moving, yet the doors stand open on empty rooms. {HERO} walks down the middle of the avenue, small. Red only: one single lit window.

jobs.name: e061
jobs.ja: 蛾の女王
jobs.prompt: A gigantic moth descends with its wings spread, glowing with a ghostly light. The patterns on its wings are made of countless human faces. {HERO} stands below, small. Red only: the moth's two large eyes.

jobs.name: e062
jobs.ja: 菌糸の人
jobs.prompt: A man with mushrooms growing all over his body walks slowly toward the viewer with open arms; thread-like fungal tendrils reach out from his chest. Grotesque and realistic. Large in the frame. Red only: the caps of a few mushrooms on his shoulders.

jobs.name: e063
jobs.ja: 逆さ時計の塔
jobs.prompt: The huge clock face of a ruined clock tower in an underground city, its hands turning the wrong way. The clock face has plain tick marks instead of numerals. Below the clock face is a small door with a blank stone plaque above it: no writing, no letters, no symbols of any kind. {HERO} stands before the door, small. Red only: the hands of the clock. Absolutely no writing, letters or alphabet anywhere in the image.

jobs.name: e064
jobs.ja: 黒い聖堂
jobs.prompt: A cathedral built of black obsidian. On the altar a black flame burns with a dark glow. The pews are empty of people, but shadows sit in them, praying. {HERO} stands in the aisle. Red only: the outline of the black flame.

jobs.name: e065
jobs.ja: 双子の扉
jobs.prompt: Two identical doors side by side in a corridor; one is carved with an open eye, the other with a closed eye (no words). In front of them stand pale twin children in identical old-fashioned clothes, speaking at the same time, with unsettling smiles. Large in the frame. Red only: the ribbons in the twins' hair.

jobs.name: e066
jobs.ja: 竜の骨
jobs.prompt: The enormous skeleton of a dragon lies across a whole cave. Inside its ribcage, a pile of treasure glints dully. Hot air shimmers up from gaps between the bones. {HERO} stands small at the dragon's skull. Red only: a large gem at the top of the treasure pile.

jobs.name: e067
jobs.ja: 影の自分
jobs.prompt: {HERO} stands in a ruin, and their own shadow on the floor has risen up by itself into a standing black figure with the same shape, facing them. The shadow speaks. Both large in the frame. Red only: the shadow's two eyes.

jobs.name: e068
jobs.ja: 仮面の商人
jobs.prompt: A merchant wearing many masks layered over one another runs a small stall in a ruined street; the stall is covered with hanging masks of human faces. The merchant leans forward to greet the viewer. Large in the frame. Red only: the mouth of the outermost mask.

jobs.name: e069
jobs.ja: 脈打つ卵
jobs.prompt: A huge egg wrapped in fungal threads, pulsing like a heart, in a fungus-filled cave. Cracks run across its shell, and something is knocking from inside. {HERO} stands small before it. Red only: the light leaking out of the cracks.

jobs.name: e070
jobs.ja: 亡者の行進
jobs.prompt: A column of dead soldiers in rusted armour marches toward the viewer through a ruined street, none of them alive, empty helmets. The standard-bearer at the front has stopped and looks straight at the viewer. Large in the frame. Red only: the tattered banner carried by the standard-bearer.

jobs.name: e071
jobs.ja: 魔女の再訪
jobs.prompt: The same swamp witch as before, a hunched old crone with wild grey hair, stirs her bubbling cauldron in a cave hut and looks up with a knowing, crooked grin, as if remembering the viewer. Hourglasses and bones hang around her. Realistic and grotesque. Large in the frame. Red only: the sand in one hourglass.

jobs.name: e072
jobs.ja: 最後のメモ
jobs.prompt: A wall of living flesh in a deep chamber. A single handwritten note is half sunk into the flesh; its writing is broken and blurred, shown only as illegible scratches, and the lines of writing continue off the paper into the flesh itself. {HERO} holds up the lantern to it. Red only: the veins in the flesh around the note.

jobs.name: e073
jobs.ja: 沈黙の司書
jobs.prompt: An endless maze of tall bookshelves. A gaunt librarian in a long robe, whose mouth is sewn shut with thread, quietly shelves books and raises one finger to the stitched lips, signalling silence. {HERO} stands in the aisle. Large in the frame. Red only: the thread sewing the librarian's mouth shut.

jobs.name: e074
jobs.ja: 血の泉
jobs.prompt: In the centre of a great hall, a stone fountain wells up with blood that overflows into its basin. Ancient marks carved on its rim are worn and illegible. {HERO} stands at the rim, looking down. Red only: the blood in the fountain; in this scene the red element may be fairly large.

jobs.name: e075
jobs.ja: 吊るされた人々
jobs.prompt: From the cap of a gigantic mushroom, people hang suspended by fungal threads like limp puppets. One of them is still alive and weakly lifts a hand toward the viewer. {HERO} stands below, small. Horrifying but not gory. Red only: the eyes of the one who is still alive.

jobs.name: e076
jobs.ja: 忘却の川
jobs.prompt: A silent grey river flows through a vast dark cavern. On its surface, fragments of memories float past as faint pale images: a house, a face, a child, a field. {HERO} kneels on the bank, cupping the water in one hand. Red only: one memory fragment, a small flower, floating on the water.

jobs.name: e077
jobs.ja: 鉄の処女
jobs.prompt: In the centre of a torture chamber stands an iron maiden, an iron coffin shaped like a woman with a serene metal face. Blood drips from the gap between its doors. Torture tools hang on the walls. {HERO} stands before it, listening. Red only: the blood dripping from the gap.

jobs.name: e078
jobs.ja: 眠る巨人
jobs.prompt: Inside the mouth of a sleeping giant that looks like a cave: enormous teeth like stalactites and stalagmites, a vast tongue as the floor, scattered with the packs, swords and helmets of swallowed adventurers, and the dark throat far behind. {HERO} stands small on the tongue. Red only: a single torn banner among the scattered belongings.

jobs.name: e079
jobs.ja: 少女の記憶
jobs.prompt: {GIRL} has stopped in a ruined street and stands with a distant look, holding her own hands together at her chest as if remembering someone holding them. Above her, faint and dreamlike, a vision of a mother's hand holding a small hand. {HERO} kneels beside her. Red only: the crest pendant on her chest.

jobs.name: e080
jobs.ja: 肉の回廊
jobs.prompt: A corridor whose walls and floor are made of living flesh, pulsing veins on the walls and the floor sagging softly underfoot, bending away into darkness. {HERO} walks in, small. Red only: the largest veins on the walls, glowing faintly.

jobs.name: e081
jobs.ja: 眼の群れ
jobs.prompt: Countless eyes have opened all over the walls of a passage: human eyes, animal eyes and nameless eyes of every size, all staring at the viewer without blinking. {HERO} stands in the middle, small. Red only: the irises of a few of the largest eyes.

jobs.name: e083
jobs.ja: 手の海
jobs.prompt: Below a rocky ledge spreads a sea of countless pale hands and arms, reaching up and grasping at the air, stretching to a distant shore. {HERO} stands on the ledge, looking down at it. Red only: a faint glow on the distant shore.

jobs.name: e084
jobs.ja: 堕ちた天使
jobs.prompt: A fallen angel with broken wings floats in the air, bound by chains. Half of its face is beautiful and serene; the other half has rotted away to the skull. It looks down at the viewer. Large in the frame. Red only: the eye on the rotted half of its face.

jobs.name: e085
jobs.ja: 名前を呼ぶ声
jobs.prompt: Total darkness. {HERO} stands frozen in the centre, refusing to turn around. Behind them, faint pale shapes of familiar figures (a mother, a friend, a stranger) reach out of the darkness, almost touching their shoulders. Red only: the lips of the nearest figure, which is calling a name.

jobs.name: e086
jobs.ja: 逆さまの階段
jobs.prompt: A staircase that twists impossibly, like an impossible-geometry drawing: it goes down, then curves up and over, with landings upside down overhead. {HERO} stands on a step, looking up at a landing above where their own earlier footprints run upside down. Red only: a lantern hanging upside down from that landing.

jobs.name: e087
jobs.ja: 自分の死体
jobs.prompt: In the middle of a passage lies a dead body identical to the hooded adventurer, with the same cloak and lantern. Its hand clutches something unknown that glows. {HERO} stands over it, looking down at their own corpse. Red only: the glowing object in the dead hand.

jobs.name: e088
jobs.ja: 深淵の司祭
jobs.prompt: A priest wearing a crown of tentacles stands before a black altar in a dark temple, arms spread in welcome, robes trailing, a dark pit behind him. Large in the frame. Red only: the priest's eyes.

jobs.name: e089
jobs.ja: 星の落ちる井戸
jobs.prompt: In a black void stands a single old stone well. Inside it, the bottom of the well shows a full starry sky, and stars fall upward out of the well into the void. {HERO} leans over the rim. Red only: one star rising out of the well.

jobs.name: e090
jobs.ja: 喰らうもの
jobs.prompt: The passage itself is a gigantic mouth: rows of huge teeth line the floor and ceiling, a writhing tongue forms the path, and a foul wind blows from the dark throat beyond. {HERO} stands at the entrance, small. Red only: a glow deep inside the throat.

jobs.name: e091
jobs.ja: 鏡の迷宮
jobs.prompt: An endless maze of mirrors. In every mirror stands a different dead version of the hooded adventurer, wounded, skeletal, drowned or burned, all shouting and pointing in different directions. {HERO} stands in the centre. Red only: the eyes of the reflections.

jobs.name: e092
jobs.ja: 騎士の亡霊
jobs.prompt: In a black void, {KNIGHT} stands alone, faintly glowing, holding his sword point-down and turning his empty helmet toward the viewer as if recognising an old friend. Large in the frame. Red only: the crown crest on the tabard.

jobs.name: e093
jobs.ja: 最後の商人
jobs.prompt: A single lantern floats in a black void, and beside it the same tall hooded peddler with no visible face, carrying a huge pack of goods, beckons with a long bony hand. Nothing else, only endless darkness. Large in the frame. Red only: the small flame inside the lantern glass; the peddler's clothes are black and grey.

jobs.name: e094
jobs.ja: 赤い月
jobs.prompt: Deep underground, a gigantic moon hangs overhead in a black void. Its surface is covered with cracks like an eggshell about to hatch, with something dark pressing from inside. {HERO} stands small on a rocky ridge below, looking up. Red only: the moon; in this scene the red element may be large.

jobs.name: n05
jobs.ja: 何度目の挑戦者
jobs.prompt: In the corner of a passage sits the ghost of an old adventurer in worn, outdated gear, grey and translucent, laughing dryly as he looks up at the viewer. Around him lie the rusted weapons and gear of many failed attempts. {HERO} stands before him. Large in the frame. Red only: a scarf around the ghost's neck.

jobs.name: x01
jobs.ja: 底の向こう（エンドレス）
jobs.prompt: Below the bottom of the labyrinth: an impossible staircase continues down into absolute darkness, surrounded by countless faint pale wisps like the whispers of unfulfilled wishes. {HERO} stands at the top, small, seen from behind. Red only: a glow at the very bottom of the stairs.

jobs.name: x02
jobs.ja: 誰かの足跡（エンドレス）
jobs.prompt: A dusty floor in a dark corridor with a single trail of footprints leading forward into the darkness, exactly the size of the adventurer's boots; no footprints come back. {HERO} stands at the start of the trail, looking down at it. Red only: the last visible footprint in the distance.

jobs.name: x03
jobs.ja: 願いの墓場（エンドレス）
jobs.prompt: A cave piled high with countless scraps of paper and torn cloth, each bearing a wish written only as illegible scribbles, like a snowdrift of discarded wishes. {HERO} stands among the piles, holding one scrap. Red only: the single scrap in the adventurer's hand.

jobs.name: x04
jobs.ja: 子守唄の残響（エンドレス）
jobs.prompt: An empty black void in which faint pale ribbons of light drift and curl like a melody made visible, flowing around an empty spot where a singer once stood. {HERO} stands listening, small. Red only: one ribbon of the melody.

jobs.name: x05
jobs.ja: 眼の欠片（エンドレス）
jobs.prompt: A floor of flesh with a shattered fragment of a gigantic eye embedded in it: a curved shard holding part of an iris, still alive and looking up at the viewer. {HERO} stands over it. Red only: the iris on the shard.

jobs.name: x06
jobs.ja: 鏡の中の踏破者（エンドレス）
jobs.prompt: A maze of mirrors. In the largest mirror stands the hooded adventurer as a battle-worn veteran who has already reached the bottom, cloak in tatters and armour scarred, speaking to the viewer. {HERO} faces the mirror. Red only: the reflection's two eyes.

jobs.name: x07
jobs.ja: 果ての商人（エンドレス）
jobs.prompt: In an endless black void, the tall hooded peddler with no visible face sits on nothing, his strange goods spread on a cloth floating in the air and his lantern hanging from an invisible hook. Large in the frame. Red only: the small flame inside the lantern glass; everything else is black and grey.

jobs.name: x08
jobs.ja: 王の使者（エンドレス）
jobs.prompt: In the darkness waits a royal messenger in a long travel cloak, holding up a staff with a banner bearing the royal crown crest, a lantern at his feet, holding out a hand toward the viewer in invitation. Large in the frame. Red only: the crown crest on the banner.

jobs.name: g025_0_r
jobs.ja: 骨の門番→銀の剣で門を断つ
jobs.prompt: {HERO} swings a silver sword through a colossal gate of bones and skulls, which shatters and collapses in a burst of bone fragments. Red only: the dying glow in the eye sockets of the great skull.

jobs.name: g050_1_r
jobs.ja: 都市の番人→王冠を掲げる
jobs.prompt: The colossal stone-and-iron guardian kneels and bows its head before {HERO}, who holds a crown high above their head, the ruined city gate behind. Red only: the furnace core in the guardian's chest, dimming.

jobs.name: g075_0_r
jobs.ja: 深淵の竜→銀の剣で立ち向かう
jobs.prompt: {HERO} drives a silver sword into the chest of a huge skeletal dragon above a chasm; the dragon rears back and begins to crumble into the void. Red only: the fire in the dragon's eye sockets, going out.

jobs.name: e023_0_r
jobs.ja: 甲冑の亡霊→共に戦うと誓う
jobs.prompt: {KNIGHT} stands before {HERO} and gives a soldier's salute, fist to chest, as his form begins to dissolve into the darkness. Large in the frame. Red only: the crown crest on the tabard.

jobs.name: e046_2_r
jobs.ja: 少女の墓→お母さまのところへ行こう
jobs.prompt: {GIRL} grips the hand of {HERO} tightly; together they turn away from a small gravestone carved with a crown crest and face a staircase leading down into darkness. The girl looks determined. Red only: the crest pendant on her chest.

jobs.name: e046_1_ok
jobs.ja: 少女の墓→墓を掘り起こす（成功）：布のお守り
jobs.prompt: An open, empty grave in a crypt, with no body in it. {GIRL} places a small hand-sewn cloth charm into the open palm of {HERO}, who kneels before her. Red only: the cloth charm.

jobs.name: n03_1_ok
jobs.ja: 騎士の告白→「あなたのせいではない」（成功）
jobs.prompt: {KNIGHT}, his helmet at his side, sits on a fallen stone in a ruin with his head lowered, and {HERO} sits beside him in silence. A long, quiet moment. Red only: the crown crest on the tabard.

jobs.name: e096_0_ok
jobs.ja: あの夜の部屋→枕元の椅子に座る（成功）
jobs.prompt: {HERO} sits in a wooden chair beside a small white child's bed in a quiet sickroom, looking down at their own open palm, where a faint glow of a remembered hand lingers. A flower on the windowsill; black nothingness outside the window. Red only: the flower.

jobs.name: e096_0_ng
jobs.ja: あの夜の部屋→枕元の椅子に座る（失敗）：あの夜の記憶
jobs.prompt: The same small sickroom, seen as a ghostly vision of a memory: the door has been flung open and the dark silhouettes of armoured soldiers stand in the doorway, while a woman's silhouette clings to a small sick child on the bed. {HERO} watches from the chair, startled. Red only: the flower on the windowsill.

jobs.name: e072_0_r
jobs.ja: 最後のメモ→最後まで読む
jobs.prompt: Close-up of a handwritten note half sunk into a wall of living flesh; the illegible lines of writing continue off the paper into the flesh as raised scars. The hand of {HERO} touches the paper. Red only: the veins around the note.

jobs.name: n04_0_r
jobs.ja: 王の手紙→一通開いて読む
jobs.prompt: Close-up: the hands of {HERO} hold an opened letter among piles of sealed envelopes; the writing on the letter is only illegible lines, blurred by tear stains. Red only: the broken wax seal of the opened letter.

jobs.name: e079_0_r
jobs.ja: 少女の記憶→歌を聞かせてもらう
jobs.prompt: {GIRL} sits on a stone and sings softly with her eyes closed; around her, faint pale ribbons of melody drift up into the darkness and are joined by another melody coming from far away. {HERO} sits nearby, listening. Red only: the crest pendant on her chest.

jobs.name: e092_0_r
jobs.ja: 騎士の亡霊→二人を救うと約束する：騎士が剣に宿る
jobs.prompt: In a black void, {KNIGHT} dissolves into light that flows into the sword held up by {HERO}; the blade begins to glow. Red only: the crown crest on the tabard of the fading knight.

jobs.name: e095_0_r
jobs.ja: 胎動する闇→少女に歌ってもらう
jobs.prompt: {GIRL} stands in a pulsing darkness like the inside of a living body and sings with her hands clasped; the darkness around her calms and parts, opening a path of faint light. {HERO} follows behind her. Red only: a heartbeat glow in the walls, quieting.

jobs.name: e082_1_ok
jobs.ja: 心臓の間→心臓に手を当てる（成功）
jobs.prompt: {HERO} presses one palm against the surface of a gigantic beating heart in a chamber of flesh; faint visions of a mother rocking a cradle drift around them like memories. Red only: the glowing crystal embedded in the heart.

jobs.name: g100_2_r
jobs.ja: 迷宮の底→騎士と共に、あの眼を討つ
jobs.prompt: {KNIGHT} kneels before {QUEEN}, who has just fallen free of a crumbling wall of flesh and sits on the floor, looking around as if searching for someone. Behind them the giant eye, pierced by two blades, collapses. {HERO} stands nearby with sword lowered. Red only: the wound in the collapsing giant eye.

jobs.name: g100_3_r
jobs.ja: 迷宮の底→「お別れを言わせてあげて」と願う
jobs.prompt: A great crack runs across the giant eye in the darkness; below it the wall of flesh unravels and {QUEEN} steps out of it as if waking. {HERO} stands with empty open hands, having given up their own wish. Red only: the crack in the giant eye.

jobs.name: g100_5_r
jobs.ja: 迷宮の底→「生きて帰りたい」と願う
jobs.prompt: {HERO} wakes lying at the entrance of the labyrinth, a dark cave mouth behind them, in dim grey dawn light, holding a small black stone from the bottom in one hand. Red only: a faint glow inside the stone.

jobs.name: g100_6_r
jobs.ja: 迷宮の底→闇の代わりに底に残る
jobs.prompt: {HERO} sits alone on a throne of black flesh and bone at the very bottom of the labyrinth, in total darkness, surrounded by closed eyes in the walls, waiting. Red only: the adventurer's two eyes glow red instead of white.

jobs.name: e001_0_r
jobs.ja: 錆びた扉→錆びた鍵で開ける
jobs.prompt: Behind an opened rusted iron door, a tiny storeroom: {HERO} kneels by shelves of dry rations and a small scatter of coins, a rusty key still in the lock. Red only: a small red cloth sack among the rations.

jobs.name: e001_1_ok
jobs.ja: 錆びた扉→体当たりで押し開ける（成功）
jobs.prompt: A heavy rusted iron door has crashed flat onto the floor in a cloud of dust; {HERO} pulls a coil of rope from an old backpack lying beyond it. Red only: rust streaks on the fallen door.

jobs.name: e001_1_ng
jobs.ja: 錆びた扉→体当たりで押し開ける（失敗）
jobs.prompt: {HERO} rebounds from a rusted iron door that has not moved at all, clutching their bruised shoulder in pain. Red only: a few rust streaks on the door.

jobs.name: e001_2_ok
jobs.ja: 錆びた扉→耳を当てて様子をうかがう（成功）
jobs.prompt: A rusted iron door stands open; beyond it only a chain sways gently in the draft, and {HERO} walks calmly through. Red only: a small rust patch on the chain.

jobs.name: e001_3_r
jobs.ja: 錆びた扉→扉には触れず迂回する
jobs.prompt: {HERO} trudges along a long, damp, dark detour passage, shoulders slumped with fatigue, water dripping from the ceiling. Red only: a faint red glow at the far end of the passage.

jobs.name: e002_0_r
jobs.ja: ネズミの群れ→たいまつを振りかざす
jobs.prompt: {HERO} thrusts a blazing torch forward and a flood of grey rats scatters away squealing into the dark corners of a stone corridor. Red only: the flame of the torch.

jobs.name: e002_1_ok
jobs.ja: ネズミの群れ→踏みつけて突っ切る（成功）
jobs.prompt: {HERO} charges through a river of rats in a corridor, stamping through them, the boots slipping. Red only: small splashes of blood under the boots.

jobs.name: e002_1_ng
jobs.ja: ネズミの群れ→踏みつけて突っ切る（失敗）
jobs.prompt: {HERO} has fallen on the floor of a corridor and is swarmed by hundreds of rats biting at their arms and legs. Red only: the rats' eyes as small bold dots.

jobs.name: e002_2_ok
jobs.ja: ネズミの群れ→息を殺して通り過ぎるのを待つ（成功）
jobs.prompt: {HERO} stands pressed silently against a corridor wall as the last of a river of rats flows away into the distance; stillness returns. Red only: the eyes of the last few rats.
